data.name: Tiruvansh
data.gender_notes: Tiruvansh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Tiru means divine, and vansh means lineage or descent. This name signifies one's divine descent or connection to the divine. The name Tiruvansh carries the meaning “God's lineage, divine descent” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Tamil. Parents who choose Tiruvansh usually hope their child will grow to embody god's lineage, divine descent and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who have a deep spiritual connection to their heritage and the divine.
data.etymology: Tiruvansh belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's lineage, divine descent.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Tiruvansh total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
